value.rationale: A complete sharp criterion distinguishes effective ordered reconstruction from unconditional reconstruction at the minimal nontrivial Hilbert dimension. It provides exact finite amplification for every direction sequence, realizes every positive decreasing residual profile, and produces two mathematically natural nested critical scales (power a=1 and log σ=1) with sharp asymptotics. This is a structural characterization with explicit rigidity/instability thresholds, not a normalization check or arbitrary finite example.
